title: Range slider
description: Range slider is used to select a value by sliding a handle.

demos.label: With steps and measure
demos.html:
| | | | |
1 2 3 4 5

demos.label: Neutral color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-neutral" />

demos.label: Primary color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-primary" />

demos.label: Secondary color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-secondary" />

demos.label: Accent color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-accent" />

demos.label: Success color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-success" />

demos.label: Warning color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-warning" />

demos.label: Info color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-info" />

demos.label: Error color
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-error" />

demos.label: Sizes
demos.html:
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="30" class="range range-xs" />
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-sm" />
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" class="range range-md" />
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="60" class="range range-lg" />
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="70" class="range range-xl" />

demos.label: Range with custom color and no fill
demos.html:
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" 
  class="range text-blue-300 [--range-bg:orange] [--range-thumb:blue] [--range-fill:0]" />

demos.label: Vertical
demos.html: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-vertical" />
